question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Fleck
solution:
The correct answer is '**Spot**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Fleck**' is '**Spot**'.
 
• **Fleck**: a very small mark on something; a very small piece of something. [(किसी वस्‍तु पर) बहुत छोटा निशान; (किसी वस्‍तु का) बहुत छोटा टुकड़ा]
 
 
• *Example: After painting the ceiling, her hair was covered with **flecks** of white paint.*
 
 
 
• **Spot**: a small round mark on a surface. (किसी सतह पर छोटा गोल निशान, चित्ती)
 
 
• *Example: Leopards have dark **spots**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Spot.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Neglect**: to give too little or no attention or care to somebody/something. [किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपेक्षा करना (बहुत कम ध्यान देना, बिलकुल ध्यान न देना या ख़याल न रखना)]
 
• **View**: an opinion or a particular way of thinking about something. [(किसी के विषय में) राय या सोचने का विशेष ढंग, विचार]
 
• **Fault**: something wrong or not perfect in a person’s character or in a thing. [(व्‍यक्ति के चरित्र या किसी वस्‍तु में), दोष]
